behavior: The resolver applies the cascade env -> machine.json -> contract default[GOOS]: a machine.json override beats the default, vars without a default (HOME/USERPROFILE) are not emitted, darwin falls back to the linux default, and home placeholders expand.
dotf env generate writes the OS-appropriate paths file, skips rewriting identical content (idempotent), and --check detects drift.
Generated lines preserve an already-set env var: sh emits ${VAR:-default}, ps1 emits if (-not $env:VAR) { ... }.
vault.ResolveVault resolves VAULT_PATH through the env cascade (no hardcoded ~/Projects/knowledge), and the whole CLI builds, vets, and tests clean.
verification: cd cli && go vet ./... && go test ./internal/vault/... ./internal/doctor/... ./internal/cmd/...
